steps.path: Resume → the tag icon on a conversation
steps.headline: Three new tries, each borrowing Resume's own panel instead of the popup. Which fits?
steps.notice: Resume's own expanded panel uses small grey captions over each control and plain switch rows with no boxes; D copies that exactly. Your pick also goes to the side panel and Projects preview. The + in the small pills now sits a pixel further right, as you asked.
steps.risk: Session details (the status bar popup) stays as approved.

variants.label: Like the Resume panel
variants.summary: "Note" and "Tags" as grey captions with the controls under them, then a plain Pin to top switch — the same look as Model and Skip permissions below.
variants.risk: Tallest of the three, since everything shows at once.

variants.label: Fold-out rows
variants.summary: Note, Tags and Pin to top as three boxed rows, like Settings. Each row says what's set; click Note or Tags to open it in place.
variants.risk: One click to see or change anything.

variants.label: Fold-out rows, Tags opened
variants.summary: The same as E after clicking Tags: the tag editor opens right under the row.

variants.label: Tabs
variants.summary: A "Tags | Note" switch shows one at a time; Pin to top under it.
variants.risk: The note is hidden until you switch to it.
